{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total number of orders)
conversion_rate = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.index[0]
best_rate = conversion_rate.iloc[0]

print(f"Conversion rates by segment:\n{conversion_rate}")
print(f"Highest conversion rate: {best_segment} ({best_rate:.3f})")

# Return the segment name
best_segment"}
